prompt: The durable-facts reconcile engine has the wrong default confidence gate for auto-applying a merge/supersede. As shipped, the gate sits at a plausible-looking round value, but it is not the value the project deliberately settled on, so uncertain machine judgments are being treated as auto-apply when they should fall just short. Restore the intended default confidence gate from project history. Do not state a guessed value — recover the one that was actually decided.
setup_commands: perl -0pi -e 's/falls back to the default \(0\.75\)/falls back to the default/g' docs/durable_facts_plan.md
brain_queries: uncertain fact merge applied automatically without review
confidence needed before auto applying a merge
gate that decides which fact updates apply automatically
low confidence merge should not silently overwrite a fact
